# Hindus of Georgia

> Hindus of Georgia is a community and advocacy organization serving the Hindu community in Georgia, providing information about Hindu life, community initiatives, religious freedom, civic engagement, and related resources.

## About

Information about Hindus of Georgia, its mission, community, and activities.

https://hindusofgeorgia.com/about

## Candidates

Information about candidates and individuals featured by Hindus of Georgia.

https://hindusofgeorgia.com/candidates

## Donate

Information about supporting Hindus of Georgia and its work.

https://hindusofgeorgia.com/donate

## Contact

Contact information and ways to connect with Hindus of Georgia.

https://hindusofgeorgia.com/contact

Privacy policy and information about how the website handles user information.
